title: Agent-generated sealed route: R143-exchangeable-transposition-dissipation
statement: Universal dissipation comparison: for every dimension n, every real unit-diagonal SPD A, and every x, E_pi[D_pi(x)] >= (1/16)||Ax||_2^2. The proposed first bridge is to derive this comparison from the random-transposition exchangeable pair and the paired residual discrepancies.

signature.representation: For a uniform permutation pi, set X_0=x, X_t=U_{pi_t}X_{t-1}, and r_t=A X_t. Couple pi to pi' by choosing two distinct update positions I,J uniformly and swapping pi_I,pi_J; (pi,pi') is exchangeable. Represent the coupling by the two residual trajectories and their discrepancy over the interval between I and J.
signature.state_or_invariant: Retain the exact dissipation D_pi(x)=sum_{t=1}^n (e_{pi_t}^T r_{t-1})^2 and the paired residual discrepancy r_t-r'_t. The governing identity is ||T_pi x||_A^2=||x||_A^2-D_pi(x), while exchangeability makes every antisymmetric function of the paired trajectories have zero expectation.
signature.core_candidate_lemma: Universal dissipation comparison: for every dimension n, every real unit-diagonal SPD A, and every x, E_pi[D_pi(x)] >= (1/16)||Ax||_2^2. The proposed first bridge is to derive this comparison from the random-transposition exchangeable pair and the paired residual discrepancies.
information_retained: The complete within-epoch residual trajectory r_t=A X_t
The exchangeable transposition pair (pi,pi') and paired trajectory discrepancy
The exact scalar energy dissipation D_pi(x)
information_discarded: Coordinate labels beyond their role in the paired residual trajectories
Cross-epoch permutation history beyond conditional independence
Higher moments and the full distribution of T_pi x once the conditional second-moment contraction is obtained
signature.target_implication: The candidate lemma and ||Ax||_2^2 >= mu||x||_A^2 imply E_pi||T_pi x||_A^2 <= (1-mu/16)||x||_A^2. Conditional Jensen and independence of fresh epoch permutations then give E||x_k||_A <= (1-mu/16)^(k/2)||x_0||_A <= exp(-mu k/32)||x_0||_A, yielding the target with C=1 and c=1/32.
signature.known_failure_mode: Order-induced cancellation may make most coordinates nearly zero when visited even though the initial residual Ax is large. Equivalently, the transposition coupling may control only a permutation Dirichlet form whose spectral gap introduces an unavoidable dimension factor, so it may not yield the claimed dimension-free 1/16 comparison.
signature.verifier_class: Agent-declared first falsifier: A later exact checker can reject the lemma by producing a rational unit-diagonal matrix A with an exact positive LDL^T factorization and a rational nonzero x for which the exactly enumerated average (1/n!) sum_pi D_pi(x) is less than (1/16)||Ax||_2^2. Alternatively, a symbolic SPD family (A_n,x_n) with this ratio tending to zero is an analytic falsifier. These checks are named but not run here.

reopen_if: An independent critic resolves the self-reported obstruction at E2+: an exact or certified counterexample sends the locked route to controlled hard-prune, while an exact rejection of that counterexample permits active reconsideration.
